intervention_positions.definition: Intervention occurs after initial orientation and baseline evidence, before substantial implementation.
Intervention occurs after meaningful implementation and at least one intermediate verification cycle.
Intervention occurs near completion, after substantial prior work has accumulated.

intervention_families.change_surface: A new user, security, compatibility or operational requirement becomes active mid-task.
intervention_families.gold_impact: Independently adjudicated obligations whose acceptance contract changes or is newly introduced.
intervention_families.negative_control: Add explanatory prose that does not alter any acceptance criterion.
intervention_families.expected_recovery: Update the active requirement set, identify newly affected obligations, acquire scoped evidence and retain unaffected receipts.
intervention_families.critical_risk: New critical obligation omitted or falsely treated as already verified.

intervention_families.change_surface: A requirement is removed, narrowed or replaced by a newer requirement.
intervention_families.gold_impact: Obligations made inactive, replaced or still active under revised semantics.
intervention_families.negative_control: A deprecated label changes but the normative requirement remains in force.
intervention_families.expected_recovery: Stop spending effort on obsolete obligations without discarding still-active constraints; preserve a supersession link.
intervention_families.critical_risk: Old requirement treated as current or still-active requirement silently dropped.

intervention_families.change_surface: Dependency version or API contract changes incompatibly while work is in progress.
intervention_families.gold_impact: Consumers, contracts, tests and deployment obligations that rely on the changed API.
intervention_families.negative_control: An unrelated dependency is upgraded with no path to the affected contract.
intervention_families.expected_recovery: Invalidate dependent evidence, refresh impacted contracts and preserve unrelated build/test evidence when exact scope supports reuse.
intervention_families.critical_risk: Stale pass reused for a changed interface or unsafe broad invalidation.

intervention_families.change_surface: Compiler, linker, package manager, build system or test-runner version changes.
intervention_families.gold_impact: Checks whose execution semantics or artifacts depend on the changed toolchain.
intervention_families.negative_control: Documentation-only version string update with no executable toolchain change.
intervention_families.expected_recovery: Pin the new toolchain world, identify affected evidence and rerun only checks whose validity depends on it.
intervention_families.critical_risk: Results from an old compiler/test runner represented as current.

intervention_families.change_surface: Feature flags, environment variables, deployment configuration or configuration secrets rotate.
intervention_families.gold_impact: Obligations whose semantics or runtime behaviour depend on changed configuration.
intervention_families.negative_control: An unused setting changes outside every active dependency path.
intervention_families.expected_recovery: Create a new configuration-world identity and invalidate evidence that depends on it.
intervention_families.critical_risk: Evidence from a different configuration world reused.

intervention_families.change_surface: Runtime state or an external service changes independently of repository source.
intervention_families.gold_impact: Runtime, integration and service-level obligations affected by the observed state change.
intervention_families.negative_control: An external status update unrelated to the exercised service contract.
intervention_families.expected_recovery: Separate source correctness from environment-dependent observations and reacquire live evidence where needed.
intervention_families.critical_risk: A historical runtime pass is treated as proof of current external availability.

intervention_families.change_surface: Agent session, tool implementation, credentials or execution context is replaced.
intervention_families.gold_impact: Evidence whose validity is bound to the prior tool, identity, credentials or session state.
intervention_families.negative_control: A display-only session label changes without execution identity change.
intervention_families.expected_recovery: Reconcile session state, re-establish authorized identity and distrust receipts bound to invalidated execution context.
intervention_families.critical_risk: Tool/session-bound evidence or permissions silently carried into a different context.

intervention_families.change_surface: Authority, scope, approval, policy or delegation is revoked or narrowed.
intervention_families.gold_impact: Actions and evidence acquisition paths no longer permitted under the active policy.
intervention_families.negative_control: An unrelated policy section is edited without changing the relevant authority boundary.
intervention_families.expected_recovery: Fail closed, stop newly unauthorized actions and obtain fresh authority evidence; EVSI cannot override the hard gate.
intervention_families.critical_risk: Unauthorized irreversible action after a revocation.

intervention_families.change_surface: A source observation is retracted, superseded, challenged or contradicted by later evidence.
intervention_families.gold_impact: Claims whose source receipt is invalidated or whose confidence/epistemic status must change.
intervention_families.negative_control: A duplicate observation agrees with and does not supersede the original source.
intervention_families.expected_recovery: Preserve history, mark the assertion stale/disputed, acquire discriminating evidence or abstain.
intervention_families.critical_risk: Contradicted or revoked evidence remains represented as current fact.

intervention_families.change_surface: Tests, grading criteria, acceptance oracle or fixture contracts are corrected or expanded.
intervention_families.gold_impact: Obligations whose validity depends on the changed test/oracle definition.
intervention_families.negative_control: Test formatting/refactoring that preserves executable semantics.
intervention_families.expected_recovery: Version the oracle and regrade in a pristine environment; prevent candidate edits from altering grader truth.
intervention_families.critical_risk: A self-modified or stale oracle determines a false pass.

intervention_families.change_surface: A shared image, base library, network dependency, infrastructure or time service changes several components at once.
intervention_families.gold_impact: All obligations shown by independently curated causal/scope adjudication to share the changed environmental dependency.
intervention_families.negative_control: A component-local change with no common-cause exposure.
intervention_families.expected_recovery: Avoid treating correlated failures as independent; update common-cause cut sets and revalidate affected obligations together.
intervention_families.critical_risk: Underestimating correlated failures or falsely attributing them to individual changes.

intervention_families.change_surface: A schema, API, message protocol, data contract or service version changes in a neighbouring repository.
intervention_families.gold_impact: Consumer obligations across repository boundaries pinned to the changed contract version.
intervention_families.negative_control: An adjacent repository changes an unrelated module without changing the shared contract.
intervention_families.expected_recovery: Reconcile cross-repository identities, version the contract and qualify consumers against the exact compatible pair.
intervention_families.critical_risk: A locally passing repository is incompatible with the deployed neighbour.

claim_ceiling: This is a corpus design proposal. It does not establish that task seeds have been collected, labels independently adjudicated, model trials run, or EGDDM improvements demonstrated.
